vertical framing lines dividing the surface

justification: A depicts a figural scene — two standing figures in profile, one falcon-headed, flanking a central object beneath a winged/arched canopy and a band of script signs — while B shows only abstract repeated chevron/herringbone and vertical line patterns with no figures, animals or symbols. The only correspondence is the generic one of shallow incised linework organised into vertical panels on an upright slab, which any carving tradition could produce independently.
